findings_aggregated_for_sde.desc: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] mitigation-confirmed (how-to I433, CORS and access control): app/init_app.py configures CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=settings.ALLOWED_ORIGINS (Starlette compares the Origin header for exact equality against this list - no contains/startsWith/endsWith partial matching and no allow_origin_regex), allow_credentials=True for the credentialed case, an explicit method list and an explicit header list rather than wildcards, and max_age=600 which is the Access-Control-Max-Age limit the how-to calls for. app/config.py builds ALLOWED_ORIGINS from the environment and filters out any '*' entry, so a credentialed wildcard cannot be configured even by an operator; the default is two explicit localhost origins. | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] mitigation-confirmed (how-to I434, CORS and anti-CSRF protection): the Origin header is not used for access control anywhere - authorization is enforced per route by the central Requires(Permission...) dependency, which the CORS layer cannot influence. app/init_app.py additionally installs CsrfMiddleware, which on any unsafe method carrying an ambient auth cookie requires an X-CSRF-Token header matching the csrf_token cookie, compared with secrets.compare_digest, and returns 403 otherwise; safe methods (GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/TRACE) are exempt so the unauthenticated preflight is not broken. | verdict=pass confidence=high
